provisioningId.description: Provisioning ID that defines how this workspace is to be provisioned for Cisco Webex Services. Each Customer Template will have their own unique Provisioning ID. This ID will be displayed under the chosen Customer Template on Cisco Webex Control Hub.

userId.description: The user ID of the workspace on BroadWorks.

spEnterpriseId.description: The Service Provider supplied unique identifier for the workspace's enterprise.

displayName.description: The display name of the workspace.

primaryPhoneNumber.description: The primary phone number configured against the workspace on BroadWorks.

extension.description: The extension number configured against the workspace on BroadWorks.

id.description: A unique Cisco identifier for the workspace.

created.description: The date and time the workspace was provisioned.
